title: Q-SAYDO-rules-CLOSED-LOOP-1: says CLOSED-LOOP-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CLOSED-LOOP-1
**Status:** open

The system states `CLOSED-LOOP-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation closedloop --check: Q-SEED-what-works: closed without evidence (silent drop)

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CLOSED-LOOP-1` exits 0.
